we can extract saliency maps without knowing the classifier in advance, that we can extract much higher quality maps than before, and that we can use these maps to improve the performance of any given classifier.

(1) we can extract saliency maps that are much more informative than those extracted with state-of-the-art methods, and (2) we can extract these saliency maps in a way that is independent of the classification model used to extract them.

(1) classifier agnostic salient map extraction allows to find parts of the image which are important to classification, not just one particular classifier; (2) classifier agnostic approach is more robust and yields higher quality salient maps than a classifier dependent approach.
